value.rationale: The exact rank-two semantic quotient is a natural quantitative resource for bounded-depth normal forms and interpolation in minimal indexed tense logic. The theorem includes a full realizability classification, a constructive finite witness bound, and an explicit exponential factor separating genuine converse semantics from independent directional modalities. These data are not specified by generic finite-rank tabularity. Sano Section 8 identifies tense cover normal forms as a direction for further research; this is an exact bounded-depth case, not a claimed resolution of the general problem. The depth-two cutoff is forced by the semantics: it is the first depth where converse constraints can be detected, rather than an arbitrary truncation.
